subject: Pilot weekend top-up — concierge credit proposal
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@curalabs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@curalabs.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot weekend support + top-up request

Hi Irene,

Quick note from the operational side at CuraLabs — we’re entering the final two weekends of our pilot with Redwood and we expect a spike in inference usage (chat routing tests + batch re-ranks). Our engineers estimate an extra ~85k tokens this weekend alone.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a small one-time credit/top-up for this weekend so we don’t hit throttling and slow tests?
- Can we get concierge support (late hours) on Sunday evening in case of regressions?

We love the latency so far — this helps our execs see the seamless production behavior. If you can confirm the credit amount and any paperwork needed, we’ll sign quickly.

Thanks — Alex

Alex Rivera
Director, ML Engineering
CuraLabs
Phone: +1-415-555-0192

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv (summary CSV)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karithik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@curalabs.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@curalabs.com>
Date: 2027-08-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot weekend support + top-up request

Hi Alex — looping in Karithik and Marissa to fast-track approval for a weekend top-up.

Summary of request: CuraLabs needs a one-time token credit (~85k) and late-evening concierge on Sunday (on-call engineer + Slack channel). They’re in the final stretch of the pilot and this is a gating factor for their internal exec demo.

Karithik / Marissa — quick context: this is deal DL-8342 (pilot, likely to convert to a dedicated seat if performance holds). Margin here is reasonable; CuraLabs projects $60k ARR uplift if pilot converts. Can we approve a limited credit and concierge window? If yes, what amount and what minimal sign-off (addendum) do we need?

If we approve, I’ll send a short addendum and confirm the DocuSign path to them.

Thanks — Irene

Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karithik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@curalabs.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@curalabs.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot weekend support + top-up request

Irene — I’m supportive of a one-off credit to remove this friction. A few specific suggestions:

- Offer a 40,000 token credit for the weekend (covers the spike and leaves them some headroom).
- Provide concierge coverage Sunday 02:00–06:00 PDT with a named on-call engineer from our SRE team.
- Require a one-paragraph addendum (one-time credit, no change to pricing) and a commitment to a 90-day post-pilot evaluation call.

Why 40k? It’s a conservative, low-cost lift for us, and it reduces our risk while keeping the ask tidy. If CuraLabs hits >120k additional usage, we can do a short emergency top-up but will require finance approval.

If that sounds good to Marissa, I’ll draft the addendum language (one paragraph) and route to legal/finance for an expedited sign-off.

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karithik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@curalabs.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@curalabs.com>, Finance Team <finance@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot weekend support + top-up request

Approved — one-time concession. Conditions below:

- Approved credit: 40,000 tokens (one-time; non-recurring).
- Concierge window: Sunday 02:00–06:00 PDT (named on-call SRE will be shared by infra ops).
- Legal/Finance: sign the one-paragraph addendum (attached: concierge_credit_terms.pdf). The addendum must be signed before we push the credit.
- Metrics: Karithik, require a quick post-weekend metrics snapshot (usage, latency, any regressions) within 48 hours.

I’m OK with the 90-day evaluation cadence. Finance, please confirm we can apply the 40k token credit under DL-8342 and confirm that this will be accounted as a one-time promotional allowance.

Marissa
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: concierge_credit_terms.pdf (one-paragraph addendum)
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@curalabs.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@curalabs.com>
Cc: Karithik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot weekend support + top-up request

Alex / Olivia — great news: we can support the weekend spike. Please see the approved items below and the next steps.

Approved items:
- One-time 40,000 token credit applied to DL-8342 (non-recurring).
- Concierge coverage Sunday 02:00–06:00 PDT (our infra ops will DM you the on-call contact).

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the attached one-paragraph addendum: https://app.docusign.com/XX-join/concierge-addendum
2) Once signed, we’ll apply the credit and turn on the concierge Slack channel.
3) Karithik will send a brief usage/latency snapshot within 48 hours after the weekend.

If you want a slightly larger buffer (we can consider an emergency top-up as a paid add-on), let me know — otherwise this should cover the demo window.

Thanks and good luck with the tests this weekend — keep us on the thread if anything pops up.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-650-555-0133

Attachments: concierge_credit_terms.pdf; pilot_usage_report.csv
